settings.printTitleHint: For example your name or your business name. Leave it empty for no title.

logoProblems.too_large: This picture is too large. Please choose one under {{size}} MB.
logoProblems.not_image: This file is not a PNG or JPG picture. Please choose another one.

settings.preview: How the top of a printed receipt will look
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
settings.remindDays: Days before the month ends to start the reminder

errors.invalid_input: Some information is not correct. Please check it and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Your data is safe. Please try again.
errors.locked: The app is locked. Please enter your password.

crash.title: Something went wrong.
crash.body: Your data is safe. You can go back and continue working.

startup.failed: Rent Tracker could not open its data. Your data has not been changed. Please close the app and open it again.

auth.recoveryPhraseHint: A sentence only you know, for example the name of your first school and your street. At least {{min}} letters.
auth.writeItDown: Write down your recovery phrase and keep it safe. If you lose both the password and the recovery phrase, nobody can open your data.

setup.title: Create your password
setup.intro: Choose a password to open the app, and a recovery phrase to use if you ever forget the password.

recover.title: Forgot password
recover.intro: Type your recovery phrase, then choose a new password.

problems.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
problems.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same. Please type them again.
problems.phraseTooShort: The recovery phrase needs at least {{min}} letters.
problems.phraseSameAsPassword: The recovery phrase must be different from the password.

auth.wrongPassword: That password is not correct. Tries left: {{tries}}.
auth.wrongPhrase: That recovery phrase is not correct. Tries left: {{tries}}.
auth.wait: Too many wrong tries. Please wait a moment. Seconds left: {{seconds}}.

areas.search: Search by area, renter or phone

empty.title: No areas yet
empty.body: Add your first area to start keeping track of rent.

areas.noMatch: No areas match. Try another word or choose All.
areas.deleted: The area was moved to Deleted items. You can restore it from Settings.

import.title: Import areas from Excel
import.intro: Bring in many areas at once. You will see what will be added before anything is saved.
import.step1: 1. Download the template and fill in one area per row in Excel.
import.step2: 2. Save it, then choose the file here (Excel .xlsx, or CSV saved as UTF-8).
import.templateFailed: The template could not be saved. Please try again.
import.newCategories: New categories that will be made: {{names}}
import.problemsHint: Fix these rows in the file and choose it again, or import the other areas now. Areas already imported are skipped the next time.
import.nothingToImport: No row can be imported. Please fix the file and choose it again.
import.changed: Something changed since the file was checked. Please choose the file again.

problem.bad_currency: currency must be IQD or USD
problem.bad_price: monthly rent must be a number, like 250000
problem.bad_price_IQD: monthly rent must be a whole number of dinars, like 250000
problem.bad_price_USD: monthly rent must be a number of dollars, like 300 or 299.50
problem.bad_month: the month must be a number from 1 to 12
problem.bad_year: the year must be from {{min}} to {{max}}
problem.bad_phone: the phone may only have digits, spaces, + and -
problem.phone_without_renter: there is a phone number but no renter name
problem.same_as_row: the same area name in the same category is already in row {{row}}
problem.already_exists: an area with this name is already in this category

file.not_readable: This file could not be read. Please choose an Excel file (.xlsx) or a CSV file.
file.too_large: This file is too large. Please choose a file smaller than 10 MB.
file.empty: This file has no areas in it.
file.too_many_rows: This file has more than {{max}} rows. Please split it into smaller files.
file.missing_columns: The first row must have the column names from the template. Missing: {{columns}}.

template.help1: How to fill in the template
template.help2: One area per row. Area name, category, currency, monthly rent, and the month and year the rent starts must be filled in; the rest may be left empty.
template.help3: Currency is IQD or USD. Monthly rent is a number: dinars, or dollars with cents like 299.50. The month is 1 to 12.
template.help4: A category that does not exist yet is made automatically. A row whose area name is already in the same category is skipped.
template.example: Example: Shop 1 | Shops | IQD | 250000 | 1 | {{year}} | Ahmad Ali | 0750 123 4567 | Main street | (notes)

areaForm.name: Area name
areaForm.currencyHint: The currency cannot be changed later.
areaForm.vacantNow: Vacant now (no rent for the moment)
areaForm.rentStartsFromFixed: Rent started from {{month}}. Use Change price for new prices.
areaForm.renterHint: Leave empty if nobody rents it now.
areaForm.renterEditHint: Fix a spelling mistake here. For a different person, use Change renter on the area page.

problems.phone: Please use only numbers, spaces and + - ( ).
problems.renterNameNeeded: Please type the renter’s name too.
problems.duplicate_name: Another area in this category already has this name. Please choose another name.

problems.duplicate_category: A category with this name already exists. Choose it from the list.
problems.renterNameKept: The renter’s name cannot be empty. If this renter left, use Change renter on the area page.

area.deleteBody: It moves to Deleted items in Settings and can be restored at any time.

figures.remainingHint: Still owed counts rent up to this month. "Received" counts money by the rent month it paid, not the day it arrived.

priceDialog.changeHint: Months before this keep their old price.
priceDialog.vacantHint: From this month the area has no rent and is never late.
priceDialog.before_rent_start: This month is before the rent started ({{month}}). Please choose a later month.
priceDialog.vacantSaved: The area is marked as vacant.
priceDialog.warning: Saving shares the money already paid out again with the new rent:
priceDialog.no_room: The money already paid from this month would have no month to go to (for example, the area stays vacant). Please cancel or edit those receipts first.

renterDialog.title: Change renter
renterDialog.name: New renter name
renterDialog.before_current_renter: This date is before the current renter started ({{date}}).
renterDialog.no_current_renter: This area has no renter right now.
renterDialog.leftSaved: The renter is marked as left.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Category name
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add one to group your areas, for example “Houses”.
categories.duplicate_name: A category with this name already exists.
categories.has_areas: This category still has areas. Move or delete them first.
categories.not_found: This category was not found. It may have been deleted.
categories.deleteBody: It moves to Deleted items in Settings and can be restored.

deletedItems.title: Deleted items
deletedItems.intro: Deleted areas and categories stay here. Restore brings them back exactly as they were.
deletedItems.duplicate_name: This cannot be restored because another item with the same name is in use. Rename that one first.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Every change to categories, areas, rents, renters and payments is listed here, newest first. Nothing on this page can be changed.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: A backup is a copy of all your data, with your settings and logo. Keep backups somewhere safe, for example on a USB drive. The app keeps the newest {{number}} backups in the folder and removes older ones it made.
backup.noFolder: No folder chosen yet. You will be asked the first time you back up.
backup.sameDrive: A copy on the same drive is lost if the drive fails. Please also copy backups to a USB drive.
backup.never: No backup has been made yet.

problems.folder_missing: The backup folder cannot be found. If it is on a USB drive, plug the drive in, or choose another folder.
problems.failed: The backup could not be made. Please try again, or choose another folder.

backup.restoreIntro: Brings back all data from a backup. You will see what the backup holds before anything is replaced.
backup.confirmRestore: Replace my data with this backup
backup.replaceWarning: This will replace all current data. A safety copy of the current data is saved first, so nothing is lost.
backup.passwordNote: The app will close and open again. Then open it with the password that was in use when this backup was made; the recovery phrase from that time comes back too.
backup.restarting: Restoring. The app will now close and open again.

refused.not_backup: This file is not a backup made by this app. Please choose a file named like rent-backup-2026-10-01.db.
refused.damaged: This backup file is damaged and cannot be used. Please try another backup.
refused.too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of the app, so this version cannot open it.
refused.failed: The backup could not be read. Please try again.
refused.cannot_upgrade: This backup could not be brought up to date for this version of the app, so it cannot be used. Your data was not changed.

backup.restoredNotice: Your data was restored from the backup of {{date}}. Open the app with the password that was in use then.
backup.restoreFailed: The backup could not be put in place. Your data was not changed.

damaged.title: Your data cannot be opened
damaged.intro: The data file is damaged. Nothing has been changed or deleted. You can bring your data back from a backup.
damaged.noBackup: If you have no backup, close the app and ask for help. The damaged file is never deleted.

paymentDialog.fromHint: The money fills this month first, then the next ones.
paymentDialog.pastHint: For money received before you started using the app. It gets no receipt number.
paymentDialog.preview: How the money is shared out
paymentDialog.too_much: This amount is more than two years of rent. Please check the number.
paymentDialog.future_date: The date received cannot be after today.
paymentDialog.cancelled: This receipt was cancelled and can no longer be changed.
paymentDialog.nothing_open: There is no rent to fill from this month: it is vacant, or more than two years ahead. Please choose another month.

receipts.title: Payments
receipts.cancelBody: It stays in the list, crossed out, and no longer counts as paid. Its number is never used again.
receipts.undone: The payment was undone. Receipt No. {{number}} is kept as cancelled.

clock.wrong: The computer date looks wrong. Late rent colours may be incorrect.

home.attentionNone: Nothing needs attention. All rent is paid up to this month.
home.chooseArea: Choose the area that paid, then press "Record payment".
home.remainingHint: Still owed counts rent up to this month.

reports.footer: "Received" counts money by the rent month it paid, not the day it arrived: rent for month {{december}} paid in month {{november}} counts toward that month {{december}}. "Still owed" counts rent up to this month.
reports.caption: Report: one row per area, then the totals per currency

results.busy: Another print is still being prepared. Please wait a moment and try again.
results.failed: Printing did not work. Please check the printer and try again.
results.past_record: A past record has no receipt number, so it cannot be printed as a receipt.
results.not_found: This receipt could not be found. It may have been cancelled.

notifications.none: Nothing needs attention. All rent is paid up to this month.
notifications.toastBody: Reminders that need attention: {{number}}. Open the app to see them.
